title: 菊花賞の後に・激流に逆らいて

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan is in the lead! She's holding onto it! Annnd she's crossed the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Even though I secured the victory, my body is still positively tingling with the pressure I felt from Creek!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. This is exhilarating!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (When Creek and I next meet on the turf, I'll be able to compete with my whole being again! That I am sure of!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Even now, the world beyond awaits us!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (How absolutely wonderful!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ardan… You truly are a formidable foe!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But next time… I will defeat you without fail!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This race has yielded some knowledge more thrilling than the victory itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I've learned that, right now, there are many potential rivals out there—many racers whom I wish to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And my races with them are sure to be wonderful occasions on which I can run with every fiber of my being.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And so, I am convinced.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As long as I have my cherished rivals, the limits available for me to surpass will remain infinite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And that surely means that the light I emit—and the dazzling trail I leave in my wake—will shine on into eternity!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a fierce race against strong contenders she's never faced before, it looks like Mejiro Ardan is sensing signs of growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her classic year draws to a close, I bet the upcoming clashes against her rivals will become even more intense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It'd probably be best to give ourselves some time to build up Mejiro Ardan's skills before running another goal race.
choice_data_list: How about we aim for the Osaka Hai next?
How about we aim for the Osaka Hai next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai! So we'd be taking the traditional route? That race determines the finest medium-distance runner of the spring, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I imagine it'll be another gathering of brilliant lights.
choice_data_list: You must be quite excited for that moment.
You must be quite excited for that moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I am, but… Oh, is it odd? For my heart to be racing so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm confident that her sheer enthusiasm will turn her running into something even more dazzling to behold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If you think so, Trainer, then I shall gladly surrender myself to this jubilant feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now, let's go back right away and review today's events. I wish to look over Creek's performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, an ecstatic Mejiro Ardan and I make our way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, unbeknownst to us…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan is in the lead! She's holding onto it! Annnd she's crossed the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Creek, Yaeno, and Ardan… They're all getting stronger and stronger…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: While I'm just…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (…It's okay. I can get stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (No. I have to get stronger…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (…In order to become a worthy rival to Chiyono O when she returns to the races someday!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai—there, I shall put on an even more radiant performance!
